# AI Systems & Business Infrastructure Education Platform

> Leverage Academy is a private, application-based education platform for builders designing AI systems, business infrastructure, and digital assets that compound over time. Founded by Khamare Clarke.

## About
Leverage Academy teaches elite builders how to create systems that generate exponential leverage — replacing effort with architecture. Not courses. Not content. Real operational systems.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — platform overview, curriculum, and application process
- /about: Founder background, credentials, and mission
- /login: Student sign in
- /signup: Create account
- /contact: Get in touch

## Curriculum Areas
- AI Agent Workflows — autonomous systems that execute complex tasks
- Revenue Infrastructure — monetization systems that operate independently
- Knowledge Systems — information architectures that scale expertise
- Distribution Engines — automated reach and influence mechanisms

## Founder
Khamare Clarke — Founder & Chief Architect
500+ systems built, 50+ ventures launched, 8+ years operating, £10M+ revenue generated
